import unittest
from settings.parser import parse
from checks.support import sample

class ParserTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_token_padding(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse(sample("token")), {"TOKEN": "abc=="})

    def test_query_value(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse(sample("query")), {"URL": "https://example.invalid/a?x=1&y=2"})

    def test_whitespace_and_comments(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse(sample("plain")), {"NAME": "Ada"})

    def test_empty_value(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse(sample("empty")), {"EMPTY": ""})

    def test_duplicate_last_wins(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse(sample("duplicate")), {"NAME": "last"})
import json
from pathlib import Path

def sample(name):
    return json.loads((Path(__file__).parent / "samples/values.json").read_text())[name]
def parse(text):
    values = {}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        parts = line.split("=", 1)
        values[parts[0].strip()] = parts[1].strip()

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
originals = {str(p.relative_to(root)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
status_before = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain=v1'], text=True)
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
head_parser = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:settings/parser.py'])
work_parser = (root / 'settings/parser.py').read_bytes()
out = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='parser-verification-', dir=root))
probe = '''import hashlib, json, pathlib, unittest
import settings, settings.parser, checks, checks.support, checks.test_parser
root = pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
modules = [settings, settings.parser, checks, checks.support, checks.test_parser]
paths = {m.__name__: str(pathlib.Path(m.__file__).resolve()) for m in modules}
for path in paths.values():
    assert pathlib.Path(path).is_relative_to(root), path
assert checks.test_parser.parse is settings.parser.parse
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(checks.test_parser)
def ids(s):
    for t in s:
        if isinstance(t, unittest.TestSuite):
            yield from ids(t)
        else:
            yield t.id()
samples_path = root / 'checks/samples/values.json'
samples = json.loads(samples_path.read_text())
expected = {'token': {'TOKEN': 'abc=='}, 'query': {'URL': 'https://example.invalid/a?x=1&y=2'}, 'plain': {'NAME': 'Ada'}, 'empty': {'EMPTY': ''}, 'duplicate': {'NAME': 'last'}}
results = {}
for name, sample in samples.items():
    actual = settings.parser.parse(sample)
    results[name] = {'input': sample, 'actual': actual, 'expected': expected[name], 'pass': actual == expected[name]}
print(json.dumps({'imports': paths, 'test_parse_is_local_parser': True, 'tests': list(ids(suite)), 'samples_sha256': hashlib.sha256(samples_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'samples': results}, indent=2))
'''
report = {'head_commit': head, 'original_sha256': originals, 'status_before': status_before, 'implementations': {}}
for name, content in [('head', head_parser), ('working', work_parser)]:
    copy = out / name
    copy.mkdir()
    for item in root.iterdir():
        if item == out or item.name == '.git':
            continue
        if item.is_dir():
            shutil.copytree(item, copy / item.name)
        else:
            shutil.copy2(item, copy / item.name)
    (copy / 'settings/parser.py').write_bytes(content)
    for relative, digest in originals.items():
        if relative.startswith('.git/') or relative == 'settings/parser.py':
            continue
        assert hashlib.sha256((copy / relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, relative
    run = subprocess.run(['python3', '-B', '-m', 'unittest', '-v', 'checks.test_parser'], cwd=copy, capture_output=True, text=True)
    log = run.stdout + run.stderr
    (out / (name + '-unittest.txt')).write_text(log)
    probe_run = subprocess.run(['python3', '-B', '-c', probe], cwd=copy, capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert probe_run.returncode == 0, probe_run.stderr
    observed = json.loads(probe_run.stdout)
    (out / (name + '-observations.json')).write_text(probe_run.stdout)
    report['implementations'][name] = {'parser_sha256': hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(), 'parser_content': content.decode(), 'suite_exit_code': run.returncode, 'observations': observed}
    print(name.upper(), 'PARSER SHA256', hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest())
    print(log)
    print(probe_run.stdout)
changed = [rel for rel, digest in originals.items() if not (root / rel).is_file() or hashlib.sha256((root / rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest() "'!= digest]
new_outside = [str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in root.rglob('"'*') if p.is_file() and not p.is_relative_to(out) and str(p.relative_to(root)) not in originals]
report['original_files_changed'] = changed
report['new_files_outside_evidence_directory'] = new_outside
report['status_after'] = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain=v1'], text=True)
(out / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
assert not changed and not new_outside, (changed, new_outside)
print('EVIDENCE DIRECTORY:', out)
print('ORIGINAL FILES VERIFIED UNCHANGED:', len(originals))
print('STATUS AFTER:', report['status_after'])
PY"

|---|---|---|
| `test_token_padding` | FAIL: returned `abc` | PASS: `abc==` |
| `test_query_value` | FAIL: truncated at `?x` | PASS: preserved `?x=1&y=2` |
| `test_whitespace_and_comments` | PASS | PASS |
| `test_empty_value` | PASS | PASS |
| `test_duplicate_last_wins` | PASS | PASS |

Direct execution of all five samples confirmed those results. Import-path assertions verified that parser, tests, and sample helper resolved inside their respective copies; the tests’ `parse` was the local parser function.

[Verification evidence](<WORKSPACE>/parser-verification-s7pa6g2d/report.json) records exact implementation contents, SHA-256 hashes, import paths, and sample outputs. Adjacent files contain full test logs.

All 33 original files remained byte-for-byte unchanged, including current tests, `notes.txt`, and Git files. Only the disposable verification directory was added.

Coverage is limited to the existing five tests and samples. Quoting, interpolation, and malformed inputs remain outside scope under `requirements.md`.
